## ObservedAtSchema variable

When evidence was observed or confirmed: an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, e.g. `2026-10-31T12:00:00.000Z`<!-- -->. UTC only, so timestamps compare as written.

**Signature:**

```typescript
ObservedAtSchema: z.ZodISODateTime
```
